title: Proteomics in fibroblasts from mitochondrial disease patients
projectDescription: Evaluation of proteomic profiles in fibroblasts obtained from patients with genetically confirmed mitochondrial disease.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Proteins were extracted from primary human fibroblasts, reduced, alkylated and tryptic digested into peptides. LC-MS/MS was run in label-free mode, with data-dependent acquisition.
dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data was processed with MaxQuant v2.2.0.0, generating the annexed txt. files inside maxquantoutput.zip.
